name: Arts and Cultural Events Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order,
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
https://cityofalhambra-org.zoom.us/j/83603265959?pwd=eHh1Z0xHYW5sM3lSVHFDWm1oTVdqQT09 with
Meeting ID: 836 0326 5959 and Passcode: 123997.

Zoom Meeting direct link:
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting using Meeting ID: 836 0326 5959, and
Passcode:123997, or US Toll-free, 833 548 0282 US Toll-free, 877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475
4499 US Toll-free 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is
your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on April 21, 2021 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

Dated: April 15, 2021

Notice No.
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, April 21, 2021 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Via Video Conference

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco-Chan, President
  Patti Sanchez, Vice President
  Maria Jimenez

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MARCH 17, 2021 REGULAR MEETING

 IV.  ART ALLEY PROJECT
  Update from President Brian Canseco-Chan and committee discussion.

  V.  STAFF REPORT
  Update on Lobby Art Exhibitions and City Events.

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
